backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing user profiles and bookings with access control, allowing creation, viewing, and status updates of booking requests.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-to-file mapping describing UI/UX requirements, related source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for fast build reference and planning.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS variables and theme tokens defining light/dark modes and global background, text, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app into the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, parent portal, and tours pages wrapped in AppShell.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout component with header navigation, responsive bubble‑styled nav links, and footer wrapping all pages.
frontend/src/components/AuthPanel.tsx: Login panel using Internet Identity with bubble styling, playful decor, and secure sign‑in flow.
Interactive calendar component allowing users to pick a date and time for bookings with month navigation and validation.
frontend/src/components/BookingConfirmat: Displays a styled confirmation modal showing booked date, time, details, and booking ID.
frontend/src/components/BubbleCard.tsx: Reusable container component applying bubble-style styling with size options.
frontend/src/components/MeetAuntieMaiaPa: Introduces Auntie Maia with an image, highlights, and a quote inside a BubbleCard.
frontend/src/components/NannyCamFrame.ts: Shows a nanny cam video feed or a placeholder message with decorative framing.
Renders decorative sticker-style images like stars or butterflies in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Gatekeeper component that waits for identity load and shows AuthPanel if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/StatusWidgets.ts: Displays nap, snack, and play status widgets using BubbleCard and icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingRequests.ts: Provides hooks to create and list booking requests via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state through context.
frontend/src/hooks/useParentPortalStatus: Fetches placeholder parent portal status including nanny cam URL and activity updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches the current user's profile using the backend actor with loading-state helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom theme variables plus utility classes for light/dark modes and bubble-style UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering the App component.
frontend/src/pages/ClubhouseHomePage.tsx: Implements the homepage with a hero section, decorative animations, feature cards, and navigation to tours.
frontend/src/pages/ParentPortalPage.tsx: Protected parent portal displaying status widgets and a live nanny cam, loading data via a custom hook.
frontend/src/pages/ToursInterviewsBookin: Provides a tour booking UI with calendar selection, details input, and booking submission using booking hooks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and container settings using custom CSS variables.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, including site vision, architecture notes, required images, and a list of existing features with their requirement links.
